test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A solid cylinder has a total surface area of 352 cm². Its curved surface area is one-eighth of the total surface area. The radius (in cm) of the cylinder is (Use pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 352 cm²

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = One-eighth of TSA

**Formulae used:**

TSA of a cylinder = 2π r(r+h)

CSA of a cylinder = 2π rh

**Calculations:**

Curved Surface Area = (1)/(8) × TSA = (1)/(8) × 352 = 44 cm²

TSA = 2π r(r+h) = 352

CSA = 2π rh = 44

h = (44)/(2π r) = (22)/(π r)

Substitute the value of h into Equation 1:

2π r(r + (22)/(π r)) = 352

2π r² + 2π r × (22)/(π r) = 352

2π r² + 44 = 352

2π r² = 352 - 44 = 308

2 × (22/7) × r² = 308

r² = (308 × 7)/(44) = 7 × 7 = 49

r = √49 = 7 cm

**∴ The radius of the cylinder is 7 cm.**
